'''Rodin Higron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]]-turned-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His base of operations was located on the [[Oasis mining colony]], in [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|The Maelstrom]].

==Biography==
Born on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Rodin Higron was a crafty [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]]. In a particularly crooked game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], Higron won sole ownership of an [[oxite]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony on a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] within [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|the Maelstrom]]. The Maelstrom was home to a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] known as the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]], and while investigating the moon, Higron realized that the Malestrom was a perfect hunting ground and established his own group of privateers. However, Higron was a staunch supporter of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and limited his targets to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military and merchant [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The moon also became the site of an Alliance [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]].<ref name="RM" />

An unfortunate side effect of this action was that Imperial forces began to tighten their grip on the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], causing a more hazardous operation for the pirate gangs. The leader of the Riders, [[Big Jak Targrim]], became particularly furious with Higron for disrupting their profitable business and tried to [[Battle of Oasis|crash]] the [[Attack on the Kuari Princess|stolen]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] into Higron's base of operations. Luckily, a small group of Rebel agents was able to foil Targrim's plan and save Higron's operation.<ref name="RM" />
